newsitem.title: FINLAND: PULP, PAPER CYCLE WEAK INTO AUTUMN - PONSSE.
newsitem.headline: PULP, PAPER CYCLE WEAK INTO AUTUMN - PONSSE.

text.p: Finnish forest harvester maker Ponsse Oy said the current weak cyclical phase in the pulp and paper industry was likely to last long into the autumn.
"The lowpoint in the buiness cycle of the pulp and paper industry is likely to last long into the autumn of this year," Ponsse said in a statement with its 1996 results.

But demand for sawn timber was expected to remain at the current high level at least until summer and timber cuttings in Ponsse's main markets would remain steady, at least at the 1996 level, this year.
Demand for forestry harvesters was likely to remain strong at least until autumn 1997 and profitability would improve as demand was now focussing on new higher-price models, Ponsse said.
In 1996, the company's profit fell 34 percent to 36.8 million markka. It said it expected higher profits this year.
